name: Human Eye (Medical-Grade Anatomical 3D Model & NCERT Fig 11.1 Horizontal Section)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomical 3D model of the human eye featuring two coordinated presentation collections: 'Eye_Full' (complete external globe with cornea, iris, pupillary sphincter, transparent crystalline lens, 4 extrinsic rectus muscles, and optic nerve bundle II) and 'Eye_Section' (canonical NCERT Fig 11.1 horizontal cutaway exposing the 3 concentric tunics—sclera, choroid, retina—ciliary body with 36 corona ciliaris folds, 48 suspensory zonules of Zinn, crystalline biconvex lens, central fovea, macula lutea, optic disc blind spot, and branching retinal arterial/venous trees).
simplifications: Equatorial horizontal cutaway removes superior hemisphere (Z > 0) matching NCERT Class 10 Fig 11.1 textbook diagram to expose internal optics, ciliary apparatus, and retinal landmarks
Suspensory zonules of Zinn represented as 48 discrete radial fibrous ligament strands attaching alternately to anterior and posterior lens equator
Retinal blood vessels modelled as primary superior and inferior temporal/nasal arcades with macular and floor branches projected on inner retinal wall

materials.look: Protective white outer fibrous tunic with biological subsurface scattering
Transparent bulging anterior aspheric refractive window (IOR 1.376)
Translucent annular transition zone between sclera and cornea

Radial ciliary folds (corona ciliaris) anchoring zonular fibers

Circumferential pupillary sphincter margin surrounding open aperture
Clear biconvex crystalline lens with optical transmission (IOR 1.406)
Delicate fibrous suspensory ligaments of Zinn
Transparent refractive vitreous humor gel (IOR 1.336)
Warm orange-red sensory photoreceptor layer with subsurface scattering
Golden-yellow macula lutea spot of high visual acuity
Central high-acuity fovea centralis depression
Pale physiological blind spot at emergence of cranial nerve II
Scarlet red oxygenated retinal arterial arcades
Royal blue deoxygenated companion retinal venules

Striated red extrinsic ocular muscle belly
Silvery glistening tendinous insertion onto sclera
